boardInputs.input: Keep Archive Archipelago distinct from System Constellation; pulse only the 45 already-real relation routes; keep owner labels persistent and move dense work labels to interaction.
Preserve archive topology vs present repository snapshot as different semantic layers; prioritize owner islands and selected works/routes over simultaneous labels.

Accessible Publication peer classified 303 ordinary Tab stops as a freeze blocker and recommended one map stop plus a keyboard-equivalent search/result path because spatial adjacency is not semantically stable.

Accessible Publication peer PASS_BOUNDED a nearest-visible-node pointer convenience only if it stays out of the semantic focus model, uses <=22 CSS px screen-space distance, visible-only candidates, deterministic ties, and drag suppression; required five destructive mobile gates.

Relation Passages peer recommended one reciprocal parent↔guided doorway only, preserving explorer vs guided-reading separation; implementation deferred until the sibling accessibility blocker is repaired and a refreshed exact source exists.
Independent source re-entry found the currently registered Relation Passages sibling still has 303 node-level Tab stops, so parent must not bind its guided doorway to that blocked exact carrier yet.

adopted: Archive and System Constellation remain separate works and ontologies.
Only exact catalogued DERIVATIVE_OF / CONSUMER_OF routes receive optional motion.
Static map labels only eight representative works; full item detail moves to interactive focus/selection.
Owner archipelagos remain spatially stable during route pulse mode.
303 map-node Tab stops are rejected; the map is one Tab stop and individual keyboard selection is carried by bounded native search-result buttons.
Conceptual spatial adjacency is not promoted into arrow-key semantic navigation.
Mobile pointer convenience resolves only currently visible Works within <=22 CSS px and is suppressed after drag; it does not create a second semantic focus model.
Reciprocal parent↔guided navigation is deferred until Relation Passages publishes a refreshed accessibility-safe exact revision.
